tool.title: OpenAPI viewer
tool.description: Render every OpenAPI document an instance's `openapi` graph holds at the visualiser's route: a hub, a page per instance listing its documents, and a page per document and per operation, drawn from the document copied beside them.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if a page is stale, instead of writing.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A site being built: write the pages at their declared route under it instead of under the harness's own site directory. A repository's own site build passes it (the tools layer's `visualiser-writers.ts`), since its harness docs are a pinned mount.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: The viewer pages, under the published site directory.

$comment.comment:
A viewer generator (`viewerTool` in `../lib.ts` holds the ports every viewer shares).
Not `openapi-ingest-*`: those copy a document in. This draws what was copied,
at the visualiser's route, because the main site serves an instance's
`openapi/` graph verbatim, as the document and its provenance, and renders no page of it.
